document_description: React Interview Questions PDF covering core React concepts

questions.question: What is React?
questions.expected_answer: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces

questions.question: What is the Virtual DOM?
questions.expected_answer: The Virtual DOM is a lightweight copy of the real DOM that React uses to improve performance by minimising direct DOM manipulation

questions.question: What is JSX?
questions.expected_answer: JSX is a syntax extension for JavaScript that allows writing HTML-like code in JavaScript files

questions.question: What are React hooks?
questions.expected_answer: Hooks are functions that let you use state and other React features in functional components

questions.question: What is the difference between state and props?
questions.expected_answer: Props are passed from parent to child and are read-only. State is managed within a component and can be updated

questions.question: What is useState?
questions.expected_answer: useState is a React hook that allows functional components to have state variables

questions.question: What is useEffect?
questions.expected_answer: useEffect is a React hook for performing side effects in functional components such as data fetching and subscriptions

questions.question: What is the component lifecycle in React?
questions.expected_answer: React components go through mounting, updating, and unmounting phases

questions.question: Summarise what this document covers
questions.expected_answer: The document covers core React concepts including components, hooks, state, props, Virtual DOM, and JSX in a question and answer format

questions.question: What are the main topics covered in this document?
questions.expected_answer: The main topics include React basics, Virtual DOM, JSX, hooks, state management, props, and component lifecycle

questions.question: What is the difference between a class component and a functional component?
questions.expected_answer: Class components use ES6 classes and lifecycle methods. Functional components are simpler functions that can use hooks
